alphaDecision.initialFailure: Without local correction, Solarized foreground over white at .90/.85/.80 was 4.09/3.45/2.90:1. These initial candidates were rejected, not silently accepted.
alphaDecision.method: Production computed colors resolved to sRGB in Chromium, including placeholder opacity and nested card/input/selected-row backgrounds. Six backing colors: white, black, red, green, blue, yellow. Existing 44% modal dimming included for mac-overlay; no dimming for goto/search. WCAG relative luminance after sRGB alpha composition. Dense black/white text captures separately inspected. This is computed-color composition, not a claim of antialiased glyph-pixel contrast.
alphaDecision.correctionEndpoint: white for dark themes; black for Catppuccin Latte; remainder after retaining the theme token weight
alphaDecision.selectionReason: .85 is the more transparent passing candidate; .80 fails text contrast.
alphaDecision.permanentRegression: chromeAccessibility.test.ts derives local correction/alpha weights from production CSS and verifies text, placeholder, selected rows, help headings and focus composition for all seven palettes against white/black backing bounds. Style contracts protect unchanged backdrop and opaque placeholders.

forcedColors.method: Chromium CDP forced-colors active plus light/dark preferred scheme; all six surfaces inspected via computed colors after transparency implementation
forcedColors.limitation: Browser emulation does not replace physical Windows high-contrast testing.
